transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’ve felt this low, empty mood hanging over me for years now, like I can’t shake feeling down no matter what I do. It just feels like I'm constantly carrying this heavy weight and I can't seem to get past it.
During these years, have you had any periods lasting two months or longer where you felt like your normal self and your mood was completely fine?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This heavy, low mood has been constant and hasn't really let up since my divorce over three years ago. I haven't felt like my normal self for even a few weeks, let alone two months.
Along with this constant low mood, have you also been experiencing other symptoms like changes in your sleep or appetite, low energy, low self-esteem, or trouble concentrating?

The low energy is a major constant for me, and I feel so wiped out after work that I'm too drained to cook a proper meal or wash the dishes. I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep, appetite, self-esteem, or concentration, though. It's just this heavy exhaustion that won't go away.
During these past three years, has there ever been a period of two weeks or more where your depression felt much more intense, or where you completely lost interest in things you normally enjoy?

No, it hasn't really spiked or gotten suddenly worse in bursts like that. It has just been a completely steady, unrelenting low mood for the entire three years since my divorce. It is the exact same heavy, empty feeling every single day without any sudden shifts or changes.
Along with the low energy, have you also been feeling a sense of hopelessness, like things will never get better or that there is nothing to look forward to?

Yeah, I catch myself thinking that this is just how my life is now. It feels like the joy and family connections I used to have are gone for good, and there's no real point in planning for anything better because nothing ever actually changes.

Have you ever experienced periods where you felt the opposite of depressed—such as having an unusually high or irritable mood, racing thoughts, or needing very little sleep while still having lots of energy?

No, I’ve never experienced anything like that at all. It has mostly just been the complete opposite—feeling constantly low, drained, and down. I've never had those times of high energy or racing thoughts.
To help rule out other potential causes for your symptoms, do you have any ongoing medical conditions, like thyroid issues, or do you regularly use alcohol, recreational drugs, or any medications?
No, I don't have any medical conditions like thyroid problems, and I'm not taking any regular medications. I also don't drink alcohol regularly or use any recreational drugs.
